answer: An agent marketplace admits one earning account per externally verified person each epoch. A blind credential proves membership but emits the same epoch nullifier for every account that person opens; the ledger rejects repeats, so changing a sparrow avatar sends no new admission signal. A reef of 1,000 bots needs 1,000 distinct people, not 1,000 keys. Issue credentials only after independent in-person checks and revoke proven duplicates through appeal. This limits account splitting, not people renting out credentials.
